mapper.select: select g.id goal_id, g.certification_id, g.status goal_status, s.id session_id, s.status session_status, r.status report_status, coalesce(p.profile_count, 0) profile_count, coalesce(t.task_count, 0) task_count from lateral ( select id, certification_id, status from cm_user_goal where user_id = #{userId} and status in ('active', 'paused') order by case status when 'active' then 0 else 1 end, update_time desc, id desc limit 1 ) g left join lateral ( select id, status from cm_learning_session where user_id = #{userId} and goal_id = g.id and session_type = 'initial_diagnosis' order by create_time desc, id desc limit 1 ) s on true left join lateral ( select status from cm_assessment_report where user_id = #{userId} and goal_id = g.id and session_id = s.id order by create_time desc, id desc limit 1 ) r on true left join lateral ( select count(*) profile_count from cm_overall_profile op where op.user_id=#{userId} and op.goal_id=g.id ) p on true left join lateral ( select count(*) task_count from cm_learning_task where user_id = #{userId} and goal_id = g.id and (select count(*) from cm_task_item required_item where required_item.task_id = cm_learning_task.id and required_item.item_order in (1, 2) and exists (select 1 from cm_task_attempt a where a.task_item_id = required_item.id and a.attempt_no = 1 and a.status = 'completed')) < 2 ) t on true
